sources.entry: Windows App - Connect to a remote PC or virtual apps and desktops made available by your admin. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Windows App
summary.one_liner: Windows App (previously Microsoft Remote Desktop) is a free Mac client for connecting to remote Windows PCs and admin-provided virtual apps and desktops.
keywords: connect to windows pc from mac
use_cases: Connect to a remote Windows PC from a Mac
Access apps and desktops published by an IT admin
Use Windows 365 or Azure Virtual Desktop from macOS
Redirect clipboard, folders, and local devices into a remote session
Manage saved remote connections in one place
summary.what_it_does: Windows App for Mac connects to Windows PCs and admin-provided virtual apps and desktops across Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, Dev Box and Remote Desktop Services. It can connect through a Remote Desktop Gateway and supports audio and video streaming. Users can redirect folders, the clipboard, and local devices such as microphones and cameras, and use multiple monitors. The Connection Center manages connections and credentials, including a Favorites page. The listing describes it as a unified client and notes it was previously named Microsoft Remote Desktop.
notable: Unified client for Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, Dev Box and Remote Desktop Services
Connection Center with Favorites page for managing connections and credentials
Redirects clipboard, folders, microphones and cameras
caveats: Access to managed resources depends on admin-provided setup; remote PCs must be configured for remote access
